environment.note: Additive, value-blind, DARK Wayond truthful-metrics foundation (ADR-0116). A pure aggregate-only metrics service (reliability/services/wayond_metrics.py), a staff-only DARK endpoint (IsAdminUser + WAYOND_METRICS_OPERATOR_ENABLED -> 404), a read-only management command, and a DARK operator UI page. No migration, no model change, no schedule/timer, no endpoint/flag enablement, no execution/broker/MT5/Copy-Trading action, no public publication. Measures existing persisted evidence and returns explicit N/A / UNMEASURABLE for every stage whose timestamp or reason is genuinely absent; broker-fill latency is kept structurally separate from internal submission latency.

expected_results: A pure, value-blind Wayond metrics aggregation service with a truthful state vocabulary (OK/PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE/EMPTY for counts; MEASURED/PARTIAL/N/A/UNMEASURABLE/UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED for latency). A latency stage yields p50/p95/p99 only with >= MIN_SAMPLE (20) valid same-or-declared-clock-domain samples; negative/forward-skew deltas are excluded fail-closed (never clamped to 0); absent evidence is N/A/UNMEASURABLE (never 0, success, or an invented duration).

Measurable latency stages: source_to_acquisition (cross-domain provider->platform), acquisition_to_approval_created (platform, via the approval FK), approval_decision_time (platform, server-commit). Explicit UNMEASURABLE: parse_start_to_complete, approval_to_submission, submission_to_broker_ack, broker_ack_to_fill, end_to_end_source_to_submission. Broker-fill latency is NEVER combined with internal submission latency (boundaries.broker_fill_separate_from_submission asserted true).

Quality/reliability counts from durable ledgers (outcome breakdown + rates, dead-letter, approval rate/time, plan held/voided + hold reasons + missing-SL, correlation completeness) and explicit N/A for duplicate rate, submission success, fill/requotes/slippage, listener liveness and flood-wait/retry. Synthetic/non-genuine excluded from the genuine cohort. Aggregate-only, value-blind (no body/handle/chat/account/email/token). Staff-only, DARK (404 until flag). Migration-free.
actual_results: Backend reliability + signal_intake: Ran 424 tests, OK. New reliability.tests_wayond_metrics (18): percentile nearest-rank correctness; _rate None-on-zero-denominator (no false 0.0); latency MEASURED/PARTIAL/N-A transitions with excluded_skew + excluded_missing; absent_stage -> UNMEASURABLE; empty-estate no-false-zero (submission/broker_fill/slippage/duplicate/listener all N/A); source_to_acquisition MEASURED cross-domain p50; acquisition_to_approval via FK; approval_decision_time; negative-skew rows excluded not clamped; outcome/stale/dead-letter; synthetic non_genuine excluded; approval_rate; broker-fill separation; value-blindness (seeded secret-shaped body/handle/account NOT present in output); endpoint unauth 401/403, non-staff 403, staff DARK 404, staff 200 when flagged. manage.py check clean.

Migration: makemigrations --check for reliability/signal_intake/execution introduces NO migration for this change (no model touched). The only drift reported is a pre-existing Django index-rename auto-naming diff on reliability.SoakSnapshot and signal_intake.ProviderCommand (neither touched by this packet) -- same class of pre-existing drift documented for the strategies app in pkt-150; deploy-neutral and out of scope.

Governance (local): check_no_secrets.py = no findings; check_evidence_manifests.py = PASS; no secret VALUE and no PII in any tracked file (tests use synthetic, secret-shaped data to PROVE value-blindness, asserting those strings are absent from the output). Frontend: next build + ESLint clean on the changed files; the new route is registered canonically in frontend/parity/routes.json.
limitations: Repository-only and DARK. The operator endpoint (WAYOND_METRICS_OPERATOR_ENABLED) is NOT enabled; no production deploy, no schedule/timer, no flag enablement. The DARK UI page does not ship with a backend-only deploy.

The foundation MEASURES existing persisted evidence only. Parse latency, broker submission ACK/FILL latency at the submission boundary, slippage, the real-path order_send round-trip, duplicate rate, DB listener liveness and flood-wait/retry are GENUINELY ABSENT and reported N/A/UNMEASURABLE -- not instrumented by this packet. Each would require additive instrumentation (a future migration + ADR) and is explicitly deferred.

Wayond is un-armed in production by policy, so execution-side plan/job/trade metrics read EMPTY (truthfully). The rich measured data is at the signal-intake layer; the end-to-end source->submission stage is UNMEASURABLE because correlation_id is absent on ExecutionJob/Trade.

Intake rows carry NO per-row synthetic discriminator; the genuine cohort is non_genuine=False with that caveat (fixture-vs-live origin is set by the invoking command, not stored). Downstream synthetic/shadow exclusion is documented for when execution is armed.

Broker-clock values (Trade.open_time/close_time) use an UNVERIFIED offset; they are a separate domain and are never combined with internal latency here. No public Wayond/broker page is activated; the publication boundary is documented only.
reviewer: Author self-review + Phase-1 five-lens repo trace (intake/decision/submission/observability/synthetic) that established, per stage, measured-vs-absent timestamps, clock domains, reason codes and correlation gaps. Adversarial review (pkt-151 Phase 6) to follow at the fabricated-speed / clock-skew / broker-fill-conflation / synthetic-contamination / small-cohort / false-zero / cross-tenant vectors; CRITICAL/HIGH fixed with regression tests before PR-ready.
